name: hud_clear_banner_names_tithe_and_stipend
description: A wave's clear banner names what else the clear paid (playtest halv s1, P12, f43548: the Beekeeper's Hive Tithe paid +4 at wave 1's clear, gold 50 to 54 beside the bonus, and the banner said only 'Wave 1 cleared · +10 gold'). The Beekeeper alone in High Water with two Clay Hives: wave 1's clear says '+10 gold · Tithe +4', read from the clear's own EV_GOLD events (two hives at 2 gold each). In a duel the stipend an uncorked pack earns is paid at every clear the same way and named too: after my tier I pack is uncorked in wave 2, wave 2's clear says 'Stipend +4'. A Lamplighter's clear keeps the plain banner (hud_clear_banner_counts_lives_lost).

steps.msg: the Beekeeper's Q is the Clay Hive
the clear names the Tithe it paid: two hives, 2 gold each

steps.assert: Game.clear_title(3, 14, 0, {'tithe': 12, 'stipend': 8}) == 'Wave 3 cleared · +14 gold · Tithe +12 · Stipend +8' and Game.clear_title(3, 14, 2, {}) == 'Wave 3 cleared · 2 lives lost · +14 gold'
steps.msg: each by name, after the bonus; nothing more when nothing more was paid
a tier I pack corked for wave 2
a duel's clear names the stipend it paid
